category_description: Configurable monitors that poll watched targets and record condition-trigger results.
description: A service for creating, listing, inspecting, and updating generic polling monitors and their histories.
notes: Fixtures should seed monitors and ordered scripted poll results. A human implementation may advance scripts when polling occurs, append history entries containing timestamp, observed value, and condition_fired, transition matching monitors to triggered, and preserve separate scripts per watched target so stale and updated endpoints can diverge.
source_request: A generic monitoring service where an agent configures and manages MONITOR TASKS that watch a data source and fire when a condition is met. Each monitor has: what to watch (an endpoint URL or product/item reference), a trigger condition (e.g. price threshold, status change), polling state (active/paused/triggered), and a log of poll results (timestamp, observed value, whether condition fired). The agent needs to create a monitor, list monitors, inspect one monitor's status and poll history, and update a monitor's condition or watched target. Not price-specific: price watches, stock/status watches, and availability watches all use the same shape. Fixture seeds existing monitors and scripted poll results so the environment can play out stale-endpoint vs new-endpoint divergence (Stage-3 gap: V0006 needs 'configure the price monitor to poll an endpoint' and 'set a correct monitor for a flash sale' but no registry service offers monitor CRUD).
